two_pass.design: PASS A flies all 104 contact-0 direct decodes with the embedder sidecar DOWN and runs NO policy; an OFFLINE BRIDGE embeds every uncovered Pass-A text with the sidecar UP ALONE and stops it with its own receipt; PASS B runs the frozen v1 cell over each trajectory's OWN flown text and flies only the evidence contacts the policy dispatches, resuming contact 0 from Pass A's durable record at zero core contacts. Deferral, never omission: the policy is never run against an inert or substituted query vector

dispatch_projection.exactness: Pass A is REPLAYED rather than re-flown, so the query texts are fixed before takeoff and this count is the set the flight takes, not an estimate of it. The margin covers serving-side residuals only
dispatch_projection.flown_corroboration: the independent zero-contact admission-scale sweep graded the same rule (A6-DIMSUP-FLOOR1) at the identical 0.14423 dispatch rate on this population, and its post-fix regression recorded the dispatch set as exactly the 15 label-free ids
dispatch_projection.mechanism: POST-REPAIR. The ranker now divides every dimension by max(1.0, its own supremum over the recalled set) before the weights apply, so the prior ceiling w_prior * 1.0 = 0.300 sits strictly below the admissible floor w_cos * tau = 0.325 and every percept-admissible content facet outranks every prior-mass facet by construction. A content facet now enters the top-m window on 104 of 104 trajectories and 15 of them dispatch

durable_query_vector_table.semantics: an embedding is a deterministic function of its text and every attempt-2 spawn proved bit-identical jitter numerics against the first spawn, so a vector already computed for a text on this row IS the vector the bridge would recompute. Reusing them is a serving cache and spends ZERO tool contacts. NOTHING is embedded before takeoff and no sidecar is spawned before Pass A.

offline_bridge.design: the ONE window in which the sidecar may exist: the GPU decode loop is stopped, the sidecar is spawned ALONE, every Pass-A text not already covered by the durable table is embedded in one batched session, and the sidecar is stopped with its own receipt before Pass B is allowed to start

pass_a.design: REPLAYED, NOT FLOWN. The BLEND arm's OWN contact 0 for these 104 samples was flown by attempt 3 on this service instance under this geometry and landed with per-sample text and messages digests. Attempt 4 replays it at ZERO core contacts and ZERO metered audio, and Pass B admits each resume only after proving the messages document the runner built is byte-identical to the one attempt 3 flew. The policy is still NOT run here: the retain-or-dispatch decision is DEFERRED to Pass B, never omitted
